interpretation_limit: Contrôle post-hoc déterministe. Le délai ~2 Myr ne reçoit aucune incertitude inventée et aucun test de significativité indépendant n’est revendiqué.
question: La décroissance canonique temporelle suffit-elle à représenter un inventaire 26Al local unique?

result.interpretation: Measured local 26Al/27Al values can depart substantially from the homogeneous canonical decay-only reference. Time dependence is real, but reservoir/mixing history also constrains local inventory.
result.no_significance_test_reason: The ~2 Myr delay is approximate and is not assigned an invented uncertainty; this is a deterministic ratio cross-check, not an independent significance test.
